items.prompt: Repaint this selected NovelAI storyboard in rough hand-painted anime with large opaque color masses and a few wide directional swipes. KEEP low-angle three-quarter camera, woman leaning back singing, lifted chin/closed eyes, face upper right, hand at heart, open palm lower left, long braid flowing left, dark teal cape against torso tilt, continuous white dress extending beyond bottom. Preserve her recognizable face and young-adult female identity. Xingyue: pale golden hair side braid into low ponytail, white crescent hairclip flat/slanted above bangs on viewer-right, ivory priestess dress, teal cape, restrained gold accents; no lantern. Paint the S-shaped wind current as one broad readable pale stroke connecting foreground palm across body into far background; its far curve becomes a few broad rain marks falling behind her. Matte cloth in principal fold planes, hair in substantial locks; selectively clear anime face and readable hands. Quiet muted background color planes chosen to distinguish white wind/dress from teal cape and hair. Handmade hard shadow edges, sparse structural lines. Remove glossy cloth, fine outlines, tiny strands/creases, confetti and texture overlays. No frame, text, UI, watermark. Square.
